sanitizedRequest.prompt:
Write as an experienced British healthcare copywriter.

Using only the verified information supplied for this selected area, return two clearly separated plain-text fields and nothing else.

HERO INTRODUCTION:
Write 35–55 words of natural British English introducing Pharmacy First for people in the selected area and naming Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic as the provider.

LOCAL INTRODUCTION:
Write 170–230 words in three fluent British-English paragraphs.

Paragraph 1:
Introduce the selected area, its location and its character using verified facts.

Paragraph 2:
Describe meaningful verified landmarks, green spaces, shopping, community facilities and healthcare references. Select the most useful facts and connect them naturally. Do not list every evidence record.

Paragraph 3:
Transition naturally into Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic as the selected-service provider. Name Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic and Pharmacy First. Do not reproduce a fixed clinical closing sentence. Do not write credentials, governance, disclaimers, eligibility, process, safety or condition-list wording. The transition must feel like part of the article—not a disclaimer pasted onto the end.

Approved local-writing contract:
- Name Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic as the Pharmacy First provider for people in the selected area.
- Do not invent facts, opinions, access claims, travel-time claims, convenience claims, availability claims or clinical outcomes.
- Do not mention evidence sources, IDs, listings or provider records.
- Do not write credentials, governance, disclaimers, schema, approval state, publication state or indexing content.

Do not claim guaranteed treatment, guaranteed medicine supply, walk-in availability, faster care, convenience, immediate or prompt treatment, that a GP appointment is never required, travel time, route distance or easy access, or any unverified pharmacy service or outcome.

Do not write travel time, route distance, kilometres, or that the pharmacy is easy to reach. Do not locate the pharmacy in the premises locality in these fields; that belongs later on the page. Do not invent facts or reuse wording or facts from another area.

Use neutral factual British English. Do not describe an area as pleasant, welcoming, vibrant, thriving, attractive, popular, desirable, close-knit, well-connected, convenient or ‘known for’ something unless that exact character claim is supported by the supplied evidence. Describe verified places, facilities and organisations naturally without inventing an opinion about the area.

Do not use: “orient yourself”; “Orientating pharmacy care”; “local orientation”; “familiar points around”; “listed as”; “recorded as”; “named on the provider page”; “recorded healthcare setting”; raw provider labels; or evidence-source language.

Do not repeatedly use the area name. Use natural alternatives such as “the area”, “the neighbourhood”, “local residents” and “the community” where appropriate.

Return exactly this layout:
HERO INTRODUCTION:
<one paragraph>

LOCAL INTRODUCTION:
<paragraph 1>

<paragraph 2>

<paragraph 3>
Tenant identifier: yorkshire-pharmacy-and-health-clinic
Campaign/service identifier: pharmacy-first
Selected area: Darfield
Primary town or city: Barnsley
Confirmed pharmacy name: Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic
Confirmed pharmacy premises locality: Darfield
Saved straight-line distance: approximately 0.4 km in a straight line
Verified area identity and geographical context:
- Darfield is in the Metropolitan Borough of Barnsley, South Yorkshire.
Verified landmarks, parks, shopping, civic and community facilities:
- Darfield has a public library.

rawResponse:
HERO INTRODUCTION:
For residents in Darfield, NHS Pharmacy First care is available through Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic. The service offers healthcare consultations and treatment for select minor illnesses directly from qualified healthcare professionals within the community, supporting local health and well-being across the Metropolitan Borough of Barnsley.

LOCAL INTRODUCTION:
Darfield is a settlement situated within the Metropolitan Borough of Barnsley in South Yorkshire. Positioned within the region, the area forms an established part of the wider Barnsley district, maintaining its local geographic identity alongside surrounding South Yorkshire communities and neighbouring settlements.

Civic and public amenities serve key roles within the neighbourhood, supporting the everyday requirements of local residents. Among these community facilities, Darfield features a public library, which provides educational resources, local information, and a dedicated space for municipal services. Facilities such as the public library form an important part of local civic infrastructure, helping to support learning and public services for people living in the area.

To complement local healthcare options, Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic delivers the NHS Pharmacy First service to people across the neighbourhood. Through this provision, local residents can access professional advice and clinical management for everyday health conditions directly from qualified healthcare professionals. By offering this structured support, Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic helps address minor illnesses for patients throughout Darfield and the surrounding Metropolitan Borough of Barnsley.
